newsHighlights.title: DR Congo Ebola Death Toll Surpasses 5,000 as Outbreak Spreads
newsHighlights.summary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo keeps spreading, pushing the death toll past 5,000 as health workers race to contain the virus.
newsHighlights.translation: 刚果民主共和国的埃博拉疫情持续蔓延，死亡人数已超过5000人，医护人员正加紧控制病毒传播。

newsHighlights.title: Africa CDC Honors Doctor Who Died Fighting Ebola
newsHighlights.summary: The Africa CDC paid tribute to a doctor who lost his life while treating Ebola patients, calling him a symbol of medical dedication.
newsHighlights.translation: 非洲疾控中心向一位在救治埃博拉患者时不幸牺牲的医生致敬，称他是医疗奉献精神的象征。

newsHighlights.title: Trilateral Cooperation Busts Drug Ring Seizing 1.2 Tons of Meth
newsHighlights.summary: Chinese, Indonesian and Malaysian anti-drug authorities jointly cracked a transnational drug case, seizing about 1.2 metric tons of liquid methamphetamine.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国、印度尼西亚和马来西亚禁毒部门联合破获一起跨国毒品案，缴获约1.2吨液态甲基苯丙胺。

newsHighlights.title: Giant Panda Lang Yue Returns to China from the Netherlands
newsHighlights.summary: Giant panda Lang Yue safely arrived in Chengdu after departing from Ouwehands Zoo in the Netherlands, and was sent for health checks and quarantine.
newsHighlights.translation: 大熊猫“朗月”从荷兰奥韦汉德动物园启程后安全抵达成都，并将接受健康检查与隔离检疫。

newsHighlights.title: Wukang Building Charms Visitors and Residents
newsHighlights.summary: Shanghai's historic Wukang Building continues to attract visitors and locals, offering a pleasant urban space that enriches everyday city life.
newsHighlights.translation: 上海历史悠久的武康大楼持续吸引游客与市民，为人们提供了一处提升日常生活品质的城市空间。

quote.author: Virgil
quote.explanation: 这句名言提醒我们：无论物质多么富有，健康才是一切的基础。正如今日埃博拉疫情新闻所示，当疾病来袭时，生命与健康远比金钱重要，预防、医疗与国际合作才是守护健康的真正财富。

vocabulary.example: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread.
vocabulary.translation: 刚果民主共和国的埃博拉疫情仍在蔓延。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 标题 'DR Congo Ebola death toll surpasses 5,000 as outbreak spreads'

vocabulary.definition: （事故、灾难等造成的）伤亡人数；代价
vocabulary.example: The death toll has surpassed 5,000 as the virus keeps spreading.
vocabulary.translation: 随着病毒持续传播，死亡人数已超过5000人。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 报道 'DR Congo Ebola death toll surpasses 5,000'

vocabulary.example: Giant panda conservation is a shared goal of China and its international partners.
vocabulary.translation: 大熊猫保护是中国与国际伙伴的共同目标。

vocabulary.example: Pleasant urban spaces like the Wukang Building area improve people's well-being.
vocabulary.translation: 像武康大楼周边这样宜人的城市空间能提升人们的幸福感与健康。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 'Wukang Building charms visitors and residents' 中关于城市生活的报道

pattern.pattern: as + 从句（随着…… / 当……时）
pattern.example: The death toll has surpassed 5,000 as the outbreak spreads.
pattern.translation: 随着疫情蔓延，死亡人数已超过5000人。
pattern.usage: as 引导时间状语从句，表示两个动作或状态同时发展，译为“随着……”或“当……时”。常用于新闻导语中描述趋势变化，后接一般现在时表示正在发生的客观情况，主句常用现在完成时强调结果。

grammar.title: 现在完成时（Present Perfect）在新闻英语中的运用
grammar.explanation: 新闻报道常使用“have/has + 过去分词”的现在完成时，强调过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或表示从过去持续到现在的状态。常见时间状语有 so far, up to now, already, yet, recently 等。在疫情、事故等报道中，用来突出最新数据与最新进展。
examples: The death toll has surpassed 5,000 as the outbreak spreads.
Giant panda Lang Yue has safely arrived in Chengdu after departing from the Netherlands.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第一个音节 /ˈaʊt/。/aʊ/ 是双元音，从 /a/ 向 /ʊ/ 滑动，口型由大到小；注意 /t/ 与 /b/ 之间的辅音连缀要干脆利落，不要在中间加入元音；第二个音节 /breɪk/ 中的 /eɪ/ 同样是双元音，发音饱满。
examples: Health experts are monitoring the outbreak closely.
The outbreak began in a remote village and soon spread to nearby towns.

reading.title: Fighting Ebola: Why Health Protection Matters to Us All
reading.content: The Democratic Republic of Congo is facing a severe Ebola outbreak. According to recent reports, the death toll has surpassed 5,000 as the virus continues to spread across the region. Health workers have been sent to the affected areas to treat patients and support local hospitals. The Africa CDC also honored a doctor who lost his life while caring for the sick. Ebola spreads through direct contact with the blood or body fluids of infected people, so prevention is extremely important. Experts advise people to wash their hands frequently, avoid touching wild animals and seek medical help as soon as symptoms appear. Quarantine and rapid testing can help stop transmission. Although the situation remains worrying, scientists say that vaccines and better medical care are saving many lives. Protecting public health requires close cooperation among governments, doctors and ordinary people.
reading.translation: 刚果民主共和国正面临严重的埃博拉疫情。据最新报道，随着病毒在该地区持续蔓延，死亡人数已超过5000人。医护人员已被派往疫区救治患者并支援当地医院。非洲疾控中心还向一位在救治病患时不幸牺牲的医生致敬。埃博拉通过与感染者血液或体液的直接接触传播，因此预防极为重要。专家建议人们勤洗手、避免接触野生动物，并在出现症状后立即就医。隔离和快速检测有助于阻断病毒传播。尽管形势依然令人担忧，但科学家表示，疫苗和更好的医疗条件正在挽救许多生命。保护公共卫生需要政府、医生和普通民众的密切合作。
reading.sourceNote: 素材来源：CGTN 报道《DR Congo Ebola death toll surpasses 5,000 as outbreak spreads》及《Africa CDC honors fallen doctor》，并结合公共卫生防控常识改写为约150词的学习短文。
